sentences.en: The longest UN climate summit in history collapsed without a final deal in Turkiye, the first such failure in 17 years.
As winter sets in, the Security Council hold a high stakes meeting Monday to discuss how Russian attacks on Ukraine's energy grid are leaving civilians without heat, power and water.
The UN Support Mission in Libya (UNSMIL) has called for an independent investigation into attacks carried out at Benghazi port and off the coast of the eastern city on Sunday.
Crowded facilities make infection control, hygiene, and clinical monitoring harder, irrespective of whatever brought a child to hospital.
A river needs a channel that stays open every year, a floodplain where water can spread, and a free path to the sea.
A timely extension would be the clearest signal of goodwill India could send to Bangladesh’s relatively new government.
The RMG wage debate is intensifying amid recent protests and factory closures as the December 1 deadline for implementing a revised structure approaches.
Local logistics company Everest Port Services Ltd has won a six-month contract to operate Chittagong Container Terminal (CCT) at Chattogram port, replacing local operator Saif Powertec Ltd.
Days after resigning while mired in scandal of extra-marital affairs, Nvidia's Jensen Huang is making a remarkable return.

attacks.def: An attempt to cause damage, injury to, or death of opponent or enemy.

climate.def: An area of the earth's surface between two parallels of latitude.

arrested.def: To stop the motion of (a person or animal).

strikes.def: A status resulting from a batter swinging and missing a pitch, or not swinging at a pitch when the ball goes in the strike zone, or hitting a foul ball that is not caught.

failure.def: State or condition of not meeting a desirable or intended objective, opposite of success.

results.def: That which results; the conclusion or end to which any course or condition of things leads, or which is obtained by any process or operation; consequence or effect.

reinstates.def: To restore to a former position or rank.

affairs.def: (often in the plural) Something which is done or is to be done; business of any kind, commercial, professional, or public.
